description: Test suite for live-test helper functions related to image-generation, including parsing filters, resolving models, and handling API keys.

methods.name: parseCaseFilter
methods.description: Parses case filters string into a set, treating empty or 'all' as unfiltered.

methods.name: parseCsvFilter
methods.description: Parses CSV strings into a set, with special handling for 'all' and empty.

methods.name: parseProviderModelMap
methods.description: Parses provider/model override strings into a Map of provider IDs to model names.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredLiveImageModels
methods.description: Resolves primary and fallback models from configuration into a map per provider.

methods.name: resolveLiveImageAuthStore
methods.description: Resolves the authorization store object based on profile key requirements and environment.

methods.name: redactLiveApiKey
methods.description: Redacts API keys for diagnostics, showing partial keys.
